title: Saturday Quick Tip
subtitle: Short or long
hook: Would your team learn more in a shorter practice?
intro: The best work happens in the first forty.
statement: Length matters less than how much of it is useful.
q1: Do you run shorter practices with more focus —
q2: or use the full time and build in variety?
q3: When does your team do its best work?
t1: Both can work. But practice pays off
t2: when every minute has a purpose.
ctaLines: Sixty focused minutes. Ninety with variety. It depends.
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Would your team learn more in a shorter practice?
Practice runs ninety minutes. The best work happens in the first forty.
Length matters less than how much of it is useful.
Shorter and focused or longer with variety. Every team is different.
Short or long practices? Share your habit in the comments.
